mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates and higher borrowing costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns show a positive correlation with FEDFUNDS (Rank IC > 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return in the highest FEDFUNDS quintile is not significantly lower than the average in the lowest quintile (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that forces restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% are not significantly lower than the average returns (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market tightness (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) coincides with elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200.0), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight labor market
failure_condition: The interaction signal (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM AND CPIAUCSL > 200.0) fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, characterized by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 1.5% QoQ) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1500.0), the market is overvalued and prone to correction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in the late-cycle regime (GDPC1 > 1.5% QoQ AND HOUST > 1500.0) are not significantly lower than the average returns (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and inflation, prompting restrictive monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where UNRATE < 4.0% are not significantly lower than the average returns (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 0.5% month-over-month, it signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns show a negative correlation with INDPRO MoM growth (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 5-day return in the highest INDPRO growth quintile is not significantly higher than the average in the lowest quintile (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns show a negative correlation with GDPC1 (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 60-day return in the highest GDPC1 quintile is not significantly higher than the average in the lowest quintile (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 0.5% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressures from a strong labor market and economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market and economic expansion
failure_condition: The interaction signal (UNRATE < 4.0% AND INDPRO MoM growth > 0.5%) fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
